up: Find all compounds referenced in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5728629'. Return molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles. sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728629'
